user.title: License plates
user.description: Identifies the plates Frigate reads against the registry. If the previous system's `plates.json` exists, it is imported when finished.

guardar.name: Save plate
guardar.description: Registers a plate or overwrites the existing one. If it was ignored, it no longer is.

matricula.name: Plate
matricula.description: Spaces and hyphens are accepted; they are removed and the plate is stored in upper case.

nombre.name: Name
nombre.description: Who it is: owner or usual driver.

avisar.name: Notify
avisar.description: Whether its arrival is notified. Defaults to yes for new plates; left unchanged on existing ones if omitted.

abrir.name: Can open
abrir.description: Whether automatic opening opens the gate for it, also when the reading is approximate. Defaults to yes for new plates.

caduca.name: Expires
caduca.description: Last day it is recognised. After that it is treated as expired: it notifies but does not open. Empty to remove the expiry.

editar.name: Edit plate
editar.description: Changes only the given fields of a registered plate.

matricula.name: Plate
matricula.description: Spaces and hyphens are accepted; they are removed and the plate is stored in upper case.

nueva_matricula.name: New plate
nueva_matricula.description: To correct the plate. The old one disappears and its statistics move to the new one.
